title: AutoContext MCP tools catalog
description: Hand-authored curatorial taxonomy for the MCP tool surface: a hierarchical category tree and the per-tool catalog entries. Conceptually similar to instructions-catalog.json, but its own shape. Curated descriptions here are human-facing presentation copy and are deliberately independent of the MCP tool descriptions in mcp-tools-registry.json.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema file. Enables editor IntelliSense.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog format version. Bumped on breaking changes.

categories.description: Presentation categories, in display order, forming a parent/child tree. Names must be unique. A category's 'parent', when present, must reference another category's name, and parent chains must not contain cycles (not expressible in JSON Schema; enforced by the loader).

tools.description: Curated per-tool entries. Every entry's 'category' must resolve to a declared category name (cross-reference enforced by the loader).

categoryName.description: A category name referenced by value (by a child category's 'parent' or a tool's 'category').

workerId.description: Worker identifier (kebab-case). Join key into workers.json. Inherited by descendant categories from the nearest ancestor that defines it; a child may override by declaring its own value.

activationFlags.description: Workspace-state flags (camelCase) that gate when the engine surfaces this category and its tools. Cumulative across the category ancestry and ANDed together (e.g. C# resolves to hasDotNet && hasCSharp).

name.description: Category name tools and child categories reference by value. Unique across the catalog.

parent.description: Name of the parent category. Omit for a root category. Must reference another declared category and must not introduce a cycle.

description.description: Human-facing category description. Independent of any MCP tool description in mcp-tools-registry.json.

name.description: MCP tool name (snake_case). Join key into mcp-tools-registry.json.

description.description: Human-facing tool description. Independent of the tool's MCP description in mcp-tools-registry.json.

category.description: Name of the category this tool belongs to. Must resolve to a declared category.
